name: DefectDojo POC Sample Findings
description: Hand-authored sample findings used to exercise the DefectDojo Generic Findings Import API during the local POC deployment.

findings.title: Hardcoded database credentials in configuration file
findings.description: The application configuration file stores the database username and password in plaintext, committed to version control.
findings.mitigation: Move credentials to environment variables or a secrets manager; rotate the exposed credentials.
findings.impact: An attacker with read access to the repository or filesystem gains direct database access.

findings.title: Outdated dependency with known CVE
findings.description: A third-party library pinned in the dependency manifest has a publicly disclosed vulnerability with an available patched version.
findings.mitigation: Upgrade the dependency to the patched release and re-run the scan to confirm resolution.
findings.impact: Depending on the CVE, could allow denial of service or remote code execution under specific conditions.

findings.title: Missing security headers on HTTP responses
findings.description: Responses from the web server do not set recommended security headers such as Content-Security-Policy and X-Content-Type-Options.
findings.mitigation: Configure the reverse proxy/web server to add the recommended security headers to all responses.
findings.impact: Low on its own, but increases exposure to clickjacking and content-sniffing style attacks in combination with other issues.
